Image Threshold

Convert any photo to pure black and white using an adjustable threshold slider.

🖼️ Drop an image here or click to browse

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an image into the tool.
  2. Drag the threshold slider until the black-and-white balance looks right.
  3. Click Download PNG to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does thresholding work?

Every pixel's brightness is compared to your threshold: brighter becomes white, darker becomes black.

Is the preview live?

Yes — the preview updates live as you drag the threshold from 0 to 255.

What is it good for?

Great for line art, stamps, silhouettes and high-contrast graphics.

What format is the download?

A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.
